element.contentText: Find out more about these delays The latest found that, among people who had cancer treatment following an urgent GP referral, the average time from referral to treatment was 74 days in England and 76 days in Wales. This is almost double our Optimal Care Pathway recommendation of 42 days. National Pancreatic Cancer Audit report These figures show that action is urgently needed to get more patients diagnosed and treated faster. They show the importance of timely scan reporting and clear communication between the specialists responsible for deciding patients’ treatment. Why do scan reports matter?
